# Stacker

> > Stacker is a data-driven storytelling platform delivering ranked lists, historical timelines, and statistical analyses across entertainment, travel, health, education, and civic topics.

Stacker combines authoritative data sources from government agencies (CDC, U.S. Energy Information Administration), industry organizations (Airports Council International, The Numbers), and research firms to create accessible, fact-based content. The site specializes in state-by-state comparisons, celebrity rankings, and historical retrospectives organized by birth year.

## Key Topics

- Historical timelines and retrospectives
- Celebrity and entertainment rankings
- State-by-state statistical comparisons
- Golden Globes and film awards history
- Travel and airport data
- Public health and safety guidance
- Environmental and emissions data
- Education rankings
- U.S. civic and constitutional information
- Data journalism and visualization
- CDC health data
- Box office and film industry metrics
- Emergency preparedness
- Military and veteran support resources

## Civic & Government Resources

- [Your Guide to the Bill of Rights and Other Constitutional Amendments](https://stacker.com/stories/government-politics/your-guide-bill-rights-and-other-constitutional-amendments): Comprehensive guide to U.S. Constitution amendments and Bill of Rights
- [How Much Carbon Dioxide Does Your State Emit?](https://stacker.com/stories/environment/how-much-carbon-dioxide-does-your-state-emit): State-by-state CO2 emissions data from U.S. Energy Information Admin

## Entertainment & Culture Rankings

- [Golden Globes Drama Winner the Year You Were Born](https://stacker.com/stories/movies/golden-globes-drama-winner-year-you-were-born): Golden Globes best drama winners by birth year from 1951 onwards
- [Books That Have Sold Over 50 Million Copies](https://stacker.com/stories/art-culture/books-have-sold-over-50-million-copies): 39 bestselling books exceeding 50M copies, including 1984 and Moby Dick
- [Every Tom Hanks Movie Ranked From Worst to First](https://stacker.com/stories/movies/every-tom-hanks-movie-ranked-worst-first): Complete Tom Hanks filmography ranked by Metacritic and IMDb scores
- [Ranking the Best MASH Episodes of All Time](https://stacker.com/stories/tv/ranking-best-mash-episodes-all-time): Top 100 M*A*S*H episodes ranked from classic TV series
- [Iconic Politically Charged Songs From 1950 to Now](https://stacker.com/stories/music/iconic-politically-charged-songs-1950-now): Political protest songs from Bob Dylan, Beatles, and modern artists
- [Highest-grossing Actors Under the Age of 30](https://stacker.com/stories/celebrities/highest-grossing-actors-under-age-30): Top 30 young actors by domestic box office earnings from The Numbers
- [Highest-grossing Actors Over the Age of 50](https://stacker.com/stories/celebrities/highest-grossing-actors-over-age-50): Top-earning actors 50+ including Samuel L. Jackson and Tom Cruise

## Education & Career

- [Best Public High School in Every State](https://stacker.com/stories/careers-education/best-public-high-school-every-state): Top-ranked public high school in each U.S. state from Niche data

## Travel & Transportation

- [20 Busiest Airports in the World](https://stacker.com/stories/travel/20-busiest-airports-world): Global airport rankings by passenger traffic from Airports Council Int'l
- [50 Most Congested Cities in America](https://stacker.com/stories/real-estate/50-most-congested-cities-america): America's most traffic-congested cities in 2018 using INRIX data

## Health & Safety Guides

- [35 Things You Need in Your Emergency Kit](https://stacker.com/stories/weather/35-things-you-need-your-emergency-kit): Emergency preparedness checklist from DHS and FEMA recommendations
- [What to Do After a House Fire](https://stacker.com/stories/weather/what-do-after-house-fire): Post-fire recovery steps from US Fire Administration and Red Cross
- [Things to Watch Out for While Outside This Summer](https://stacker.com/stories/health/things-watch-out-while-outside-summer): Summer outdoor hazards and health risks to avoid in the U.S.
- [What to Watch Out for in the Water This Summer](https://stacker.com/stories/health/what-watch-out-water-summer): Major aquatic threats and water safety hazards for summer swimmers

## Community & Lifestyle

- [87 Top Rated Charities to Support Military Members and Their Families](https://stacker.com/stories/military/87-top-rated-charities-support-military-members-and-their-families): Charity Navigator-rated nonprofits supporting military and veterans
- [Breaking Down Babysitting Costs Across the U.S.](https://stacker.com/stories/business-economy/breaking-down-babysitting-costs-across-us): Babysitting rates across U.S. metro areas using UrbanSitter data
- [What Marriage Rates Were the Year You Were Born](https://stacker.com/stories/retrospective/what-marriage-rates-were-year-you-were-born): Historical marriage rate trends by birth year using CDC/NCHS data
- [Most Popular Male Dog Names](https://stacker.com/stories/pets/most-popular-male-dog-names): Most popular male dog names from Rover and pet industry data
